name: semantic-scala
description: Read-only declared Scala effect-wrapper evidence for local Codex workspaces.

interface.longDescription: Inspect declared effect-like return types in a local Scala source file with the exact semantic-scala Alpha-3 CLI. This skills-only package is scoped to Codex environments with a local Linux x86_64 workspace and Python 3.11 or later. It does not use MCP or run builds.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the declared effect wrapper for a Scala method in the current workspace.
